title: lre-world-v1
description: A LumiRPEngine world as this engine writes it: one JSON document per revision. Collections are keyed by id. Formulas are expression-language strings and dice are notation strings. An older document is brought up to date by migrate (load does it) before it is checked against this schema.

engineVersion.description: The engine version that last wrote the document.

packs.description: Enabled packs by id, each with the pack format version the world was authored against and its config.

pins.description: Pinned generator versions and data-table revisions.

maps.description: Maps by id (lre-map-v1): the source of truth for the places, grids and routes they compile into.

suppressed.description: Sources of adopted user entries, a retired design: kept for the format; nothing reads them.

mapSettings.description: How the map shows the world, and the optional grid system. Absent: knowledge display, movement off, sight 3.

movement.description: The grid system: walls and doors steer the POV, things lie in cells, cells and zones trigger rules.

sightRadius.description: Cells the POV sees around it; read as a whole number up to 32.

seedMode.description: Action seeds: a fresh seed per Re-run, or the same roll for the same path and action.

lenientPricing.description: Accept a narrated price inside its band.

pov.description: The POV entity; never capped, whatever its tier.

spawnTier.description: The tier a spawned entity gets when it names none.

spawnCap.description: Characters replies may introduce in a chat, in total. Absent: 24.

lifeStates.description: The world's own life states besides alive, dying and dead, by id. Absent: only those three.

start.description: Where and when the POV starts: a place id and an ISO local date-time.

economyConfig.description: The economy pack's config (DESIGN §25): the world's account products, its Custom money feature toggles and its assets; other keys (a module's, such as taxes) are allowed.

unpricedCap.description: The most a narrated price nothing else prices is charged, in minor units.

products.description: Account products by id: a class, and the terms that differ from its defaults.

features.description: Custom toggles: a money feature switched on from its floor up, or off.

assets.description: Assets the holdings module prices, by id.

expr.title: a formula
expr.description: a formula in the expression language

minds.title: character minds
minds.description: Character minds: what the narrator gets of a mind, the fidelity ladder's weights and thresholds, the author's pins and the memory defaults. Every part is optional; one left out, or out of range, reads as the default.

secrecy.description: full: the narrator gets each mind's monologue and intent, to depict and never state; brief (the default): only a depiction, checked for leaks.

weights.description: Points each input adds to a character's focus score, from -100 to 200.

nearby.description: Under the same parent place as the POV. Default 20.

mentioned.description: Named or addressed in the latest message or reply. Default 40.

regard.description: Regard between them and the POV (the axes' mean, whichever way is stronger) at its extreme, scaled by its size. Default 10.

knows.description: A knows relation with the POV either way. Default 10.

owner.description: Owns a track under way. Default 15.

track.description: Each track under way whose stages name them, up to three. Default 8.

roles.description: Role facet values by value id; a value nested under a weighted one counts as it. Default antagonist 20.

rule.description: Named by a world rule. Default 5.

pending.description: Each pending interaction with the POV, up to three. Default 15.

band.description: The detail band their tier maps to. Defaults 15, 5 and 0.

recent.description: Seen with the POV lately, fading over a day. Default 10.

thresholds.description: The lowest score for Live, Near and Far; under far is Background. Read in order: live at least near, near at least far. Defaults 60, 35 and 15.

never.description: People who never get a mind; wins over always.

memory.description: How minds remember; a user's overrides win.

show.description: Witness log lines shown to a mind. Default 8.

recent.description: The latest turns they were there for. Default 4.

relevant.description: The turns they were there for that best match the moment. Default 4.

show.description: Notes shown to a mind. Default 8.

keep.description: Notes kept before the oldest are folded into the summary. Default 24.

show.description: Open commitments shown to a mind; all are kept until resolved. Default 8.

halfLifeDays.description: Game days in which a note's salience halves. Default 7.

floor.description: A note under this salience has faded. Default 0.5.

enabled.description: Fold faded and surplus notes into the summary. Default true.

periodDays.description: At most how often a character's notes are folded, in game days. Default 1.

selector.title: a selector
selector.description: Which entities something applies to: every constraint given must hold, a list matches any of its values, an empty selector matches every entity.

effect.description: An effect: a core or pack effect type and its arguments, each a value or a "=" formula.

pool.description: A current value under an evaluated max (hit points, mana); number fields only.

max.description: a field of the same entity, or a formula with the entity as self

derived.description: computed from this formula and never stored

table.description: a text field naming a row of this table

until.description: game minutes: the end of a time-bounded relation

lifeState.description: A life state: its label, whether someone in it still acts, and how the narrator reads it after their name.

life.description: the life state it starts in; absent: alive

lifeKnownBy.description: who knows the life state it starts in, besides itself; everyone else takes it for alive. Absent or empty: everyone

cues.description: what the narrator sees them do while a secret of theirs stays hidden (the Stance section)

cue.description: behaviour, never the secret; it stands for one secret: a lore entry, a track or a story flag

anyOf.title: a cue for lore (text and lore)
a cue for a track (text and track)
a cue for a story flag (text and flag)

layoutPos.description: position on the parent's node map

items.description: thing id → the cell it starts in

table.description: a text param naming a row of this data table (a skill, a save)

check.title: a check
check.description: A dice expression plus outcome bands, with exact odds.

vs.description: The other side of an opposed check.

description.description: what the action does, in a line; interpret's catalog gives it the model

outcomes.description: effects per check outcome; default when there is no check

combat.description: a combat action: offered only where the ruleset has combat, taken on its actor's turn

cost.description: budget id → how many it spends; empty: it's free

role.description: how everyone else's tactics use it

epoch.description: ISO local date-time; game minutes count from here

custom.description: A custom calendar's months and weekdays.

anyOf.title: an entity, group or kind id

target.description: the field or relation a slot's value sets

given.description: the previous slot's value → its distribution

truth.description: the secret truth: GM-only until revealed

schema.description: lre-table/<tableId>/v<n>: the row shape version the pack reads

revision.description: computed from the schema, columns and rows; never authored

rows.description: rows keyed by stable row id

tierCaps.description: Caps per detail band; the POV is never capped.

sceneTicks.description: default tick per scene type, in minutes

speedThrough.description: activity → how Speed through handles it

rank.description: lower ranks are kept first on the section budget

links.description: entity and place ids the entry is about

visibility.description: who may read a non-secret entry: everyone (absent or public), or only once the POV knows every person and place it links

audience.description: the helpers that may read a secret entry before its gate holds

holders.description: the people whose own secret it is: their minds read it, gate or no gate

terms.description: a lowercase term or alias → the ids of the entries it means

lore.description: one of the world's lore entries

book.description: one of the user's Lumiverse World Info books

entry.description: an entry of that book, read from it whenever it is used

lorePins.description: Lore pinned where calls always read it first, within their lore tokens: a character's mind calls, and every helper and mind call at a place or inside it. Absent: none.

characters.description: entity id → the entries pinned to that character

places.description: place id → the entries pinned to that place

multiple.description: whether an entity may hold several values

anyOf.title: a list of XP per level, from level 1

adjudication.description: When checks roll and who settles them. A named preset plays as its own values; custom keeps them as edited, and a value it can't hold is clamped when read.

riskyAt.description: with risky: a check rolls only when its success chance is below this (0–1)

trivialAt.description: a chance at or above it passes without a roll; null never does

impossibleAt.description: a chance at or below it fails without a roll; null never does

closeBy.description: with hybrid: points from another outcome that make a close call, 0–20

retryAfter.description: with changed: game minutes before the same check may roll again, up to a week

ruleset.description: The world's tabletop ruleset; every part is optional.

minLevels.description: the lowest effective level each domain plays at, whatever the realism settings

combat.description: Combat and encounters; its parts are checked by the engine's lint.

stalemate.description: whole rounds in a row with no attack and no one hurt that end a fight as a stalemate (default 3; 0: never)

profile.description: the profile the ruleset last started from (Build → Ruleset → Start from a profile)

currency.description: How money displays; state keeps integer minor units. Other keys (a template's denominations and notes) are kept and not read.

decimals.description: minor units per major unit as a power of ten
